description: This file contains functions for translating FAPI PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) PDUs into internal data structures, including filling reserved RE patterns, codewords, power values, and resource block allocations, as well as converting the entire PDSCH FAPI PDU to a physical layer representation.

methods.name: fill_reserved_re_pattern
methods.description: Fills the reserved RE pattern list in the PDSCH PDU based on CSI-RS indices.

methods.name: fill_codewords
methods.description: Populates the codewords in the PDSCH PDU with modulation and redundancy version info.

methods.name: get_power_control_offset_ss_dB
methods.description: Returns the power control offset in dB based on the profile.

methods.name: fill_power_values
methods.description: Sets power-related parameters in the PDSCH PDU based on power configuration profiles.

methods.name: get_mapping_type
methods.description: Determines the VRB to PRB mapping type from FAPI enum.

methods.name: make_vrb_to_prb_config
methods.description: Constructs VRB to PRB configuration based on transmission type and resource allocation.

methods.name: fill_rb_allocation
methods.description: Fills the resource block allocation in the PDSCH PDU, either type 0 or type 1.

methods.name: convert_pdsch_fapi_to_phy
methods.description: Converts a FAPI PDSCH PDU into internal physical layer data structure, filling all relevant fields.
